count_mpesa_amounts(df)[source]¶

Counts the number of mpesa transactions.

Extracts the month and year from the time_stamp. Replaces the amount spent with the actual amount spent, drop the mpesa_id and timesamp, groupby the borrower_id, month, and year then find the sum for all the transactions.

impute_missing_columns(df, required_columns)[source]¶

Inserts missing columns in a data set.

Given a dataframe extract and sort columns present in the dataframe. Compare it to the required columns and insert any columns that is required but missing with default values extracted from phone types.

Parameters

  • df (obj) – A dataframe

  • required_columns (list) – A list containing columns that

prepare_images(df)[source]¶

Prepares images data for prediction

Remove image/ from the image_file_type column, convert the same column to categorical variables using pd.get_dummies, drop the corporate_id and remove columns with the string missing. Confirm that no columns are missing or addtiional unwanted columns are present and retrun the final df.

Parameters

df (obj) – the images dataframe

Returns

A prepared dataframe

Return type

df (obj)

prepare_messages(df)[source]¶

Prepare messages for prediction.

Drop the corporate_id column, convert message_type and the message_direction columns to a string, the message_time_stamp column to date and do a pd.get dummies on message_type and message_direction. Drop the message_INBOX column, extract month and year from message_time_stamp, and drop columns the string ‘missing’. Remove any additional columns and insert any required columns that are missing.

Parameters

df (obj) – The images data set

Returns

image summarised dataset.

Return type

df (obj)

prepare_mpesa(df)[source]¶

Prepares mpesa data

Covnvert columns to their appropirate data types and convert categorical variables to dummy variables. Remember when fetching data there were columns that were missing. So drop any such columns in addition to the corporate_id and mpesa_spec_loc. Using the impute_missing_columns method defined in this class, repalce missing columns and remove unwanted columns.

Parameters

df (obj) – The mpesa data set

Returns

Cleaned dataset.

Return type

df (obj)
